name: supply_chain
description: Third-party JS/CSS supply chain risks. Checks for: SRI integrity missing on external scripts/stylesheets, scripts loading from known-bad or deprecated CDNs, vulnerable library versions via nuclei tech-detect.

quick.description: nuclei supply chain templates on live hosts. ~10 min.

standard.description: nuclei supply chain + katana JS file crawl + bad CDN detection. ~30 min.

exhaustive.description: All standard + deep JS library version analysis + threat_alert CDN checks from /alerts/. ~90 min.
